calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Lahti%'
  AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name, category, subcategory
FROM dim_product
WHERE (product_name LIKE '%Interior Paint%' 
   OR category LIKE '%Interior Paint%'
   OR subcategory LIKE '%Interior Paint%'
   OR category LIKE '%Paint%' AND subcategory LIKE '%Interior%')
  AND is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY sku

calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND fsl.store_key = 13
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
